svg.title: Day AI: CRM records and meeting context through Day AI's MCP server
svg.desc: Inside your agent, the DayAI capability connects to Day AI's hosted MCP server at day.ai/api/mcp with an OAuth access token, and the model sees the server's tools under the day_ai_ prefix. The server marks no tool read-only, so there is no read_only option. Wrapping the capability's toolset with approval_required() pauses every Day AI tool call until you approve it.
